note: Curated order-of-magnitude reference values for the demo seed. Figures are rounded from the cited public statistics; they calibrate synthetic farms/loans/policies, they are not a statistical product. Author: Nitya Prakash Pandey.

BD.avgFarmHaSource: BBS Agriculture Census 2019 (Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics): mean operated area per farm holding ≈ 0.5 ha
BD.farmHouseholdShareSource: BBS Agriculture Census 2019: ≈16.9 M farm holdings of ≈35.5 M households
BD.priceSource: FAOSTAT 2023 paddy yield; DAM Bangladesh Aman procurement/market paddy ≈ BDT 33-36/kg
BD.loanRateSource: Bangladesh Bank agricultural & rural credit policy FY2025-26 (SMART-linked cap ≈ 9-12 %)

VN.avgFarmHaSource: GSO Rural, Agricultural & Fishery Census 2016 / IPSARD: Mekong Delta rice households farm ≈ 1-1.3 ha (national ≈ 0.5 ha)
VN.householdSizeSource: GSO Population & Housing Census 2019: 3.5 persons/household (Mekong Delta)
VN.farmHouseholdShareSource: GSO 2020 mid-term agricultural census: ≈ 40-45 % of Mekong Delta households farm
VN.priceSource: FAOSTAT 2023 paddy yield; Mekong IR50404/OM5451 fresh paddy ≈ VND 6,500-8,000/kg (2024-26)
VN.loanRateSource: State Bank of Viet Nam priority-sector caps + Agribank/VBARD agricultural lending 2024-26 (6-9 %)

PH.avgFarmHaSource: PSA 2012 Census of Agriculture and Fisheries: national mean farm 1.29 ha; PhilRice RBFHS Central Luzon rice farms ≈ 1.5 ha
PH.householdSizeSource: PSA 2020 Census of Population and Housing: 4.1 persons/household
PH.farmHouseholdShareSource: PSA: ≈ 5.6 M farms nationally (≈ 24 % of households); Central Luzon is more urbanised (≈ 15 %)
PH.priceSource: FAOSTAT 2023 paddy yield; PSA palay farmgate ≈ PHP 19-23/kg (2024-26)
PH.loanRateSource: Rural/thrift bank agri-loan rates 8-12 % (ACPC & BSP reports; subsidised ANYO/SURE programmes lower)

IN.avgFarmHaSource: Agriculture Census 2015-16 (MoA&FW): Odisha average operational holding 0.95 ha
IN.farmHouseholdShareSource: Agriculture Census 2015-16: ≈ 4.9 M operational holdings in Odisha vs ≈ 9.6 M households
IN.priceSource: FAOSTAT 2023 paddy yield; GoI MSP common paddy 2025-26 INR 2,369/quintal
IN.loanRateSource: Kisan Credit Card crop loans 7 % (4 % with prompt-repayment subvention); term loans ≈ 9 %

ID.avgFarmHaSource: BPS Sensus Pertanian 2023: most Java farm households are 'petani gurem' (< 0.5 ha); Java mean ≈ 0.3-0.5 ha
ID.householdSizeSource: BPS 2020 Population Census / SUPAS: ≈ 3.6 persons/household (Central Java)
ID.farmHouseholdShareSource: BPS ST2023: 29.3 M farm households nationally (≈ 38 %); lower on urbanised north-coast Java
ID.priceSource: FAOSTAT 2023 paddy yield; HPP gabah kering panen IDR 6,500/kg (Bapanas 2025)
ID.loanRateSource: KUR (Kredit Usaha Rakyat) micro 6 %; commercial agri loans ≈ 10-12 %

districtRuralAdjust._note: Share of the farm-household rate that applies to districts dominated by a city (population figure includes the urban core).

productionCostUsdHa._note: Cost of cultivation per hectare per season — basis for indemnity sums insured (PMFBY uses the district 'scale of finance', which approximates cost of cultivation). Converted at 2026 FX.
productionCostUsdHa._sources: BD: DAE/BBS cost of production (Aman ≈ BDT 95-110k/ha); VN: IPSARD/Sub-DoA Mekong (≈ VND 26-30 M/ha per crop); PH: PSA Production Costs and Returns of Palay 2023 (≈ PHP 65-75k/ha); IN: Odisha SLTC scale of finance for paddy 2025-26 (≈ INR 60-66k/ha), CACP cost A2+FL; ID: BPS Survei Ongkos Usaha Tani (≈ IDR 16-19 M/ha)

insurancePremiumPct._source: World Bank / GIIF index-insurance reviews and PMFBY actuarial rates: weather-index 3-8 % of sum insured; area-yield 4-7 %; indemnity/MPCI 6-10 %

loanSizeUsd._source: VN: Agribank/VBARD household agri loans commonly VND 50-500 M (median ≈ VND 100 M); PH: rural-bank/Landbank production loans PHP 25k-600k (median ≈ PHP 100k)

anticipatoryCash._source: WFP/BRAC Bangladesh anticipatory cash for monsoon floods & Cyclone Remal (2020-2024): BDT 4,500-5,000 per household

floodLossModel._note: Loss estimate used for historical floods and archived alerts (see real/README.md).
floodLossModel.floodedShare: clamp(0.005 + 0.35·(1 − e^(−depth/0.7))·(0.4 + 0.6·min(1, days/14)), 0.002, 0.5) of the district's vulnerable area
floodLossModel.seasonFactor: 1.0 when the event falls in the main wet-season crop window, 0.5 otherwise
